embeds.title: Issue **#508** opened: Particle rendering is busted
embeds.description:
Seems like a combination of Valve updating some of the particle stuff, and our code not handling certain things.
It needs a loving pass to fix up the existing stuff we have. I committed a few fix which should ease the task.
